title: Studio: customize an installed package's dataset, showing what else it changes before the customer publishes
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

The maintainer: 「全部立，继续测试验证」 (2026-11-04), on the seat's evaluation of which metadata types should support override.

Measured by the seat through the metadata API and in a browser on `main` `63b86b385d`, on `examples/app-crm` and `examples/app-showcase`, each overriding through its paired customization package. No `domain:*` label is set: triage routes this card.

## Business reason

A vendor's dashboard says 在途商机总额, and the customer defines that figure differently. They can edit the dashboard, not the number under it, and Studio shows the dataset as 只读. A dataset feeds every dashboard and report built on it, so changing one changes them all. The person must be able to see that before publishing.

## Measured

- The override of `opportunity_metrics` with `total_amount`'s `aggregate` changed from `sum` to `avg`: publish `published`, and the running dashboard's 在途商机总额 moved from ¥814,400 to ¥135,733.
- Removal returned ¥814,400.
- Changing that measure's `field` to `expected_revenue` was refused at publish. The seat did not read why; the refusal has to reach the person in the door.

## Acceptance

1. A read-only base's dataset offers 定制, saved as a whole copy into the pair with the declaration, with 恢复原版.
2. Before publish, the person sees which dashboards and reports use this dataset. Use the existing 引用关系 read if it answers this.
3. A publish refusal is shown in the Console's language at the item.
4. Marks, the 仅看定制 count and the All metadata tile cover datasets.
5. A browser check: change a measure, publish, see the dashboard change, restore, see it return.
6. No server or spec change is expected. If one is needed, report it here.

## Where

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioCustomizeControls.tsx:73`. `dataset` is overridable by `OVERRIDE_TYPE_CLASSIFICATION`. A dataset's designer door in a read-only package was not measured.

## Re-check

`git grep -n "  dataset: listed" origin/main -- packages/spec/src/kernel/customization-package.ts`
